title: Smart Parking Availability Prediction and Compliance Risk Mapping for Melbourne CBD
author: Srihari Chandran, Abhey Sharma
description: This analysis investigates parking efficiency and congestion reduction across Melbourne's CBD by analysing parking sensor data, restriction rules, and spatial off-street capacity data. The project builds a compliance risk scoring framework that classifies parking bays into Low, Medium, and High risk categories based on restriction complexity, enforcement hours, and rule count. A Random Forest classifier achieves 99% accuracy in predicting compliance risk. An interactive folium map visualises risk levels across all 3,209 on-street bays, and a geospatial supply gap analysis reveals that every CBD bay has over 7,600 off-street spaces within 400 metres, reframing the parking problem as an information issue rather than a supply shortage. Recommendations are provided around dynamic pricing, improved signage, and off-street wayfinding.
